business_summary.text: Gopal Snacks Limited is a packaged foods company manufacturing and selling snacks like gathiya, namkeen, snack pellets, and wafers under the Gopal Namkeen brand.

call_points.text: FY27 EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 8-9% with exit run rate near double-digits
Q1 saw 5% raw material inflation, with 4.2% passed on to consumers via price hikes and grammage reduction
Rajkot facility recommencement expected to improve manufacturing efficiency through lower logistics and operating costs
Five consecutive quarters of sequential revenue growth; current run rate at ₹150+ Cr per month

industry: Fast Moving Consumer Goods > Food Products > Packaged Foods

operating_notes.text: Insurance proceeds received in FY26: ₹37.4 Cr; additional ₹35-40 Cr expected in Q2FY27
New products introduced in FY26: Kaju Biscuits, Popcorn, Cupcakes, contributing ₹38 Cr revenue growth
Distributor count increased to 953 (from 884 in Q3FY26)
Current run rate at ₹150+ Cr per month
38% of outlets now getting double service weekly

timeline.summary: Gopal Snacks held Q4FY26 earnings call on May 13, 2026; with Rajkot plant commissioned and Gondal facility to be discontinued.
Q1FY27: Revenue ₹422 Cr (+31.1% YoY), EBITDA margin 7.4%; reaffirmed FY27 guidance of ₹1,800-1,900 Cr revenue and 8-9% EBITDA margin

watchlist.response: Partially offset through grammage reduction and price hikes; monitoring situation weekly
watchlist.text: Raw material inflation impact on margins

watchlist.response: Working capital cycle remains in comfort zone; negotiating trade payable days
